# Carnot Research Roadmap v696 — Repeatable evidence and bounded-history learning

**Created:** 2026-10-02. **Milestone:** 2026.10.696.
**Status:** Planned; this task does not activate the roadmap.
**Supersedes:** completed scheduling for 2026.10.695; sequence695 becomes696.

The contract contains **13 tasks, Exp8031 through Exp8043**, in the exact order
shown below. The visible task table, complete executable JSON and full-task digest
agree with `research-roadmap-next.yaml`. The active roadmap remains V695.
The stale V694 document previously occupying this path is already preserved
byte-for-byte as `research-roadmap-v694-preserved-20261002.md`. No V695 design is
invented retrospectively.

## What v695 proved

The archive currently ends at V694. The active V695 YAML, terminal artifacts and
conductor records establish that its scheduling finished. Twelve task primaries
use their planned paths; Exp8024 has a conductor gate-skip receipt at
`results/experiment_8024_likelihood_decision_test.json`, not its planned path.
An `OK` in the archive or log does not establish a scientific positive.

| Evidence | Supported finding | Limit and next action |
|---|---|---|
| Exp8018 | Authority checks caught a stale design and missing machine contract | `contract_ready_score=0`; supply and validate complete V696 authority now |
| Exp8019 | Current final artifact qualifies complete targets: fit238, tune62, calibration61, stream254, retention63 | Changelog retains an earlier disqualification; bind current primary plus terminal sidecar and preserve both versions |
| Exp8020 | Calibrated small-head fitting completed | No independent decision benefit follows; use the qualified head as a fixed learning start |
| Exp8021 | 254 decision groups were measured | Required coverage was incomplete; capstone's descriptive mean cost gain was -0.1811, not an improvement |
| Exp8022 | Fixed-answer token scoring qualified on a small canary | This did not guarantee repeatability at calibration scale |
| Exp8023 | 384 forwards scored64,992 answer tokens | Duplicate mean-NLL drift0.00637696 exceeded1e-6; likelihood calibration disqualified |
| Exp8024 | Conductor gate skipped evaluation | No source-correctness comparison exists |
| Exp8025 | Delayed sparse learning, equal budgets and durable reload qualified | Benefit remained null; new study changes replay support rather than reweighting priorities |
| Exp8026 | Independent replay and recovery diagnostics ran | Retention labels were opened before protocol freeze; Brier-priority retention drift0.04325 is descriptive, unqualified evidence |
| Exp8027 | Numerical native parity was measured; later atomic-inode repair passed scoped checks | Original artifact remains disqualified; measure new transactions only after normal process-exit qualification |
| Exp8028 | Qualified supervisor scan found no new outcomes | No ARC gain; inspect only new event identities |
| Exp8029 | Board custody remains valid | 24-bit emulation had drift0.00133335 and one action disagreement; test conservative fallback before device work |
| Exp8030 | Independent reduction kept the three science gaps open | Historical publication `paper_ready=true` does not imply `science_ready=true` |

Original numerical results, failed logs and disqualifications remain unchanged.
A repaired implementation is a new prerequisite, not retroactive scientific credit.

## Three biggest gaps to the PRD vision

1. **Useful source-grounded decisions — FR-06/12.** Source sensitivity has not
   established correct decisions. The next branch first isolates scoring drift,
   then tests new likelihood measurements against independent human targets and
   identical-information controls. These are exposed development results.
2. **Learning that improves later decisions — FR-11.** Sparse updates and storage
   work, but retained causal benefit is unqualified. A fixed recent-feedback
   buffer versus cumulative replay changes the mechanism under equal feedback,
   gradients and starting state. This branch does not depend on GPU capture.
3. **Reproducible affordable deployment — FR-05/08/09/10 and NFR-01.** Complete
   authority and current evidence must survive independent readers. Full durable
   transaction cost, native parity and numerical fallback must qualify before
   speed claims or hardware purchases. ARC remains the live discovery destination;
   offline replay and board history cannot substitute for it.

The original PRD's energy-ground-truth vision is a research target. A learned
compatibility score is not a proof of correctness or a substitute for annotation.
No task trains the27B generator, launches a new puzzle gallery, or reopens retired
external-text reranking, importance anchoring or small-graph sampler sweeps.

## Research recorded before design

The V696 scan in `research-references.md` was appended before task design.
It covers all eight requested topics and all six secondary-source channels.
Semantic Scholar citation endpoints were inaccessible; OpenReview's EBT page
required browser verification; a Hugging Face GASP page returned a cache miss.
These limits remain explicit. No exhaustive novelty or live trend claim is made.

| Source | Concrete local consequence |
|---|---|
| [CoRun, August2026](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14376) and [LLM-42, January2026](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.17768) | Exp8033 separates state lifecycle and execution shape; no transfer of serving-stack guarantees |
| [GASP, July2026](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04223) | Exp8034–8037 measure fixed-answer source intervention with duplicate controls and human targets |
| [To Retain or to Adapt, July2026](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.05609) | Exp8038–8039 test recent versus cumulative replay and report future loss and retention separately |
| [EBT,2025](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.02092) and [ARM–EBM v4,2026](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.15605) | Exp8035 keeps small conditional energies and an exact sigmoid parity control |
| [KAC,2025](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.21076) and [KAN-CL,2026](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.12306) | Sparse spline updates remain a cheap substrate; no importance-anchoring rerun |
| [FPGA–ASIC co-design,2026](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.15985) and [Extropic Z1T, September2026](https://extropic.ai/writing/z1t/) | Exp8040/8042 include storage, transfer and fallback; published efficiency is not local efficiency |

T-SKM-Net/PAL, ETS/ERM, HalluTracer, OpenHalDet and Kona remain leads.
Another solver, decoder or internal activation probe would broaden the program
before the current source-decision question is answered. Exp8032 records the
method-to-code mapping and explicitly identifies these deferred directions.

## Architecture

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A[8031 complete immutable authority] --> Z[8043 independent capstone]
  H[V695 public roles and qualified historical head] --> P[8032 methods sealed before evaluator access]
  R[8033 context and shape scoring diagnosis] --> F[8034 fit/tune Qwen likelihoods]
  P --> F
  F --> E[8035 calibrated small energy and classifier controls]
  E --> V[8036 reserved development Qwen likelihoods]
  R --> V
  V --> D[8037 independent human-target decisions]
  E --> D
  P --> L[8038 CPU recent-history versus cumulative replay]
  L --> I[8039 independent later-loss retention and recovery]
  L --> N[8040 loaded native durable transaction costs]
  B[Historical board receipts] --> Q[8042 custody and bounded numerical fallback]
  L -. optional qualified trace .-> Q
  N -. optional qualified costs .-> Q
  S[8041 only new live supervisor outcomes] --> Z
  D --> Z
  I --> Z
  N --> Z
  Q --> Z
```

Scoring workers see source text and fixed answers, never evaluator labels.
Fit/tune and evaluation sources keep their original source-disjoint roles.
The likelihood signal is full mean NLL plus no-source-minus-full NLL.
Human annotation refers only to the original full-source response.
The learning branch uses the qualified historical scalar/source feature geometry,
not the new likelihood heads. This keeps a failed GPU canary from erasing FR-11.
All reused corpora are historically exposed; current seal order does not undo that.

## Phase1 — Qualify evidence and freeze methods

**Exp8031, contract:** bind table, complete JSON, digest and actual invocation
YAML with existing parameterized readers. Check consumed staging and UTC rollover
on private fixtures. No science branch gates on administrative success alone.

**Exp8032, sealed methods:** freeze public role identities and overlap rules before
annotation access. Reuse likelihood fit64/tune32/evaluation96 and learning
stream256/retention64 slots. Preserve complete-label eligibility and unknowns.
Pass evaluator labels only through the declared release/evaluation boundary.

**Exp8033, scoring isolation:** use eight label-free fit sources and a four-condition
state/shape experiment. Existing reset-only behavior is the baseline. Fresh native
contexts, fixed chunks and immediate owned copies of logits test specific causes.
At most128 target passes,80,000 answer tokens and900s model work. Readiness needs
all duplicates within1e-6 and full normalization/alignment checks. No relaxed gate.

Phase prototype: existing readers plus a bounded changed scorer. Validation:
complete authority, access-order tests and exact scoring operands. Adversarial
checks: missing JSON, stale prompt, premature label access, shifted tokens and
stale native buffer. No scaling occurs if the scorer fails.

## Phase2 — Test source information and calibrated decisions

**Exp8034, fit capture:** run64 fit and32 tune groups under full, duplicate and
no-source views through the qualified scorer. Maximum288 passes,110,592 scored
answer tokens and1800s model work. Stop admission on duplicate drift or alignment
failure. Require48 complete fit and24 complete tune groups.

**Exp8035, energy training:** use full NLL and source-intervention delta to fit a
small binary additive spline energy. Compare intercept, full-NLL-only and two-
feature logistic controls. Exact energy/sigmoid equivalence is a parity control,
excluded from architectural benefit comparisons. Fit-only group cross-validation
chooses ridge; tune calibrates affine logits. No evaluation label or generator
weight update is permitted. Require fit48 with8/class and tune24 with4/class.

**Exp8036, evaluation capture:** run the96 original evaluation source slots,
maximum288 passes and110,592 answer tokens, with the same qualified model and
schedule. Require72 complete groups and seal token outputs before evaluator use.
This is a reserved development role, not newly unseen external evidence.

**Exp8037, decision test:** seal all probabilities and actions, then open human
targets. Require72 independent complete groups and8/class. Test source-information
and energy-architecture hypotheses separately. Report per-source costs, Brier,
false accepts, abstention, action changes, failures and exclusions.

Phase prototype: small loadable energy/classifier checkpoints and token-level
measurements. Validation: complete targets, source separation, support floors,
convergence, calibration and independent reduction. Adversarial checks: duplicate
placebos, unknown labels, sign inversion, zero headroom and edited prediction seals.
A fully measured negative still qualifies measurement; no test depends on a win.

## Phase3 — Continuous self-learning over bounded history

**Exp8038, online learning:** hold the qualified Exp8020 starting head and original
feature geometry fixed. Issue each of256 stream predictions durably before labels
arrive at original slot plus20. After each16 eligible releases, spend four updates.
Compare uniform selection from last64 releases, cumulative releases and newest16;
include frozen no-write. Adaptive arms share step size0.01, ridge0.001, cap64 updates
and seeds101–120. Rows may recur across blocks; the journal counts repeated use.
The mechanism changes which past constraints remain available to the updater.
It does not change acquisition, generator weights or the prior loss-priority rule.

**Exp8039, independent audit:** reconstruct coefficients and later actions from
primitive features and released labels. Test retained decisions and real private
process crash recovery. Report support overlap with frozen fit-only strata.
Historical retention exposure is disclosed. Seeds measure algorithm variability;
there is one chronological development environment, not20 independent streams.

Phase prototype: sparse CPU learner with a bounded replay buffer and durable
issue/release/update records. Validation: equal gradients/labels, later cost,
retention and exactly-once recovery. Adversarial checks: future-label mutation,
reordered releases, duplicate commits and a no-op learner. No generalization
claim is licensed by these finite-trajectory comparisons.

## Phase4 — Measure deployability and close the evidence record

**Exp8040, native transaction cost:** first pass the shipped atomic-inode regression
with normal process exit. Reuse the loaded Rust/PyO3 kernel; measure current replay
selection, feature gathering, arithmetic, FFI, serialization, fsync and reload.
Use30 paired randomized repetitions after five warmups, with600s numerical budget.
Kernel-only speed is secondary. Missing feature-acquisition or label-provider
costs prevent a claim about the complete current verification service.

**Exp8041, ARC supervisor delta:** reuse the qualified scanner after Exp8028's
frontier. No new events means an immediate valid null. With adequate outcomes,
propose only curated-arm selection changes that could transfer through the live
entrypoints. No game execution, re-solving, new strategy arm or submission occurs.
Imported live events retain their solve provenance; no new solve is claimed.

**Exp8042, precision fallback:** preserve each board's independent evidence. If a
current learning trace qualifies, propagate numerical error bounds for the24-bit
state/32-bit accumulator. Use float64 CPU state when the resulting probability
interval crosses a typed-action boundary. Require containment, zero remaining
action disagreement, no unhandled overflow and matching restart decisions.
Measure fallback share and bound compatible arithmetic acceleration including
transfer and storage. No device runs; absent numerical inputs do not erase custody.

**Exp8043, capstone:** independently reconstruct all13 dispositions, including
actual gate-skip receipts. Reduce the three hypotheses and three PRD gaps from
primitive evidence. Keep G1–G4 historical publication readiness separate. Correct
reader execution may finish while science is terminal blocked. Record scoped
retirement and a concrete changed prerequisite for reopening failed mechanisms.

Phase prototype: actual loaded native calls, interval/fallback replay and existing
terminal readers. Validation: normal exits, parity, complete cost components and
exact contract accounting. Adversarial checks: mapped-inode replacement, threshold
crossing, tampered updates, absent primary artifacts and false solve provenance.

## Scientific acceptance contract

Freeze all choices in Exp8032 before current evaluator access. The small likelihood
panel is a bounded research test; there is no guaranteed power to show a win.
No null result licenses increasing sample size until significant.

| Primary hypothesis | Comparison | Minimum effect and safeguards |
|---|---|---|
| H1: source information | Two-feature logistic vs full-NLL-only logistic | Brier reduction>=0.01; mean typed cost increase<=0.01; no additional false accepts |
| H2: energy decisions | Two-feature spline energy vs two-feature logistic | Mean typed cost reduction>=0.02; Brier increase<=0.01; no additional false accepts;>=5 beneficial changed decisions |
| H3: bounded-history learning | Window64 vs cumulative replay | Later mean typed cost reduction>=0.02; no additional false accepts; retention Brier increase<=0.01 and cost increase<=0.02 for both arms;>=5 beneficial changed decisions |

Costs are unsupported accept5, supported reject1, escalation0.5 and correct0.
The target is probability of unsupportedness. Select the minimum expected-cost
action with escalation on ties: accept below0.1, reject above0.5, otherwise escalate.
These thresholds are fixed, not selected from evaluation targets.

Use10,000 paired source-group bootstrap draws for H1/H2 and moving-block draws
of length32 for H3, with16/64 sensitivity. Test inversion evaluates the nonzero
registered margins. Apply one-sided Holm at0.05 over exactly H1/H2/H3. An absent,
disqualified or unsupported comparison contributes p=1. Preserve descriptive
intervals and all safety gates. This is conditional finite-corpus uncertainty,
not a claim of independent deployment generalization.

H3 needs>=192 eligible stream source groups,>=20/class,>=160 post-first-update
scored decisions, retention>=48 and>=8/class. Duplicate calls, algorithm seeds
and bootstrap draws never enlarge independent sample counts. Tail feedback not
yet due stays censored. Unknown human targets stay unknown, not negative.

`*_ready_score` ordinarily means complete qualified measurement and owned checks,
not benefit. Structured gates also require verdict_class in [positive, null] and
flagged_adversarial=false. `capstone_execution_ready_score` is specifically a
reader-execution result and cannot open a scientific gate. `partial` is reserved
for unfinished owned work. Missing external inputs are terminal `blocked`.

## Dependency graph and execution order

Conductor order is Exp8031–Exp8043. Solid edges below are structured readiness
gates; each is also checked for terminal verdict class and adversarial status.
Dashed edges are optional inputs. Every gated field is named in its producer's
REQUIRED ARTIFACT FIELDS and belongs to this roadmap.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  P[8032] --> F[8034]
  Q[8033] --> F
  P --> E[8035]
  F --> E
  P --> V[8036]
  Q --> V
  E --> V
  P --> D[8037]
  E --> D
  V --> D
  P --> L[8038]
  P --> A[8039]
  L --> A
  L --> N[8040]
  L -.-> W[8042]
  N -.-> W
  C[8031] -. accounting .-> Z[8043]
  S[8041] -. accounting .-> Z
  D -. accounting .-> Z
  A -. accounting .-> Z
  N -. accounting .-> Z
  W -. accounting .-> Z
```

Exp8033 may diagnose scoring before the scientific protocol qualifies; it uses
only label-free fit inputs. Exp8041, board custody in Exp8042 and Exp8043 remain
runnable when scientific branches fail. The capstone reads failures, not only wins.
Exp8038/8039/8040 remain independent of the new likelihood branch. Historical
artifacts are authenticated inputs, never retired upstream `requires:` chains.

## Hardware, model and time requirements

| Resource | Role | Limit |
|---|---|---|
| CPU and system RAM | Small-head training, replay, independent reduction, native calls | Existing host; bounded buffers; no full generator training |
| CUDA RTX3090 pair,24GB each | Exp8033/8034/8036 fixed-answer Qwen scoring | One owned available device at a time; record real offload and memory reserve; no forced dual-GPU work |
| `unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-GGUF`, Q4_K_M | All three tasks needing an LLM | Embedded GGUF tokenizer/template; hash exact file/revision; cache miss blocks with no legacy fallback |
| KV260 | Preserve authenticated SSH-accessed fabric scope | k_max<=5; no board operation in this milestone |
| PolarFire | Preserve Linux CPU-only evidence | Do not relabel as fabric acceleration |
| GateMate | Preserve physical/JTAG block | Unchanged0xffffffff needs a changed physical prerequisite, not another probe |
| NPU/TSU and wishlist devices | Future operation mapping | Unqualified locally; no purchase proposed |

Exp8033/8034/8036 use `model_load_no_generation` with the2s diagnostic floor:
all answer tokens are supplied and scored; generation APIs are forbidden.
Record forward passes and scored tokens separately from zero generated tokens.
No task invokes bounded generation. If future scope adds a small completion,
its class must become `model_bounded_generation` (10s); real open generation is
`model_full_generation` (60s). Floors never justify sleeping or fabricated time.
All other tasks have `MODEL_SPECS=[]`, `no_model_load`, and zero current
pretrained-model calls. Imported Qwen features retain source receipts only.

The task estimates total430 minutes (7h10m), with early gates expected to reduce
that when prerequisites fail. Per-task estimates include implementation/checks;
model-work and numerical caps are separately fixed in prompts. Each task must
print at phase boundaries, before/after minute-scale operations, inside loops
and every60s while children run, keeping every output gap below600s. Files over
about200 lines must be written across bounded tool calls with progress messages.
Use existing runners and reusable readers rather than new per-task frameworks.

CPU sparse gather/dot/update can move to Rust/SIMD; FPGA support would require a
new compatible kernel, not the existing Ising bitstream. A hypothetical100x
arithmetic speedup is an Amdahl scenario. Record its measured serial fraction,
state traffic and numerical fallback before claiming end-to-end improvement.

## Failure discipline, routing and validation

Every task declares actual prior verdicts, a changed mechanism or prerequisite,
and `retire_if_same_verdict: true`. Standing2026-05-29 overrides apply only to
specified transition, hardware-continuity or changed versioned continuations.
The complete contract and capstone do not rewrite V695's failed determinations.
Unchanged no-event ARC input ends cheaply. Failed score parity cannot be bypassed
by a renamed readiness field or a smaller model.

Routing follows the current user directive: formulaic cohort and native-binding
work use Codex/gpt-6.1-sol; routine research uses Claude/Sonnet. Contract/preflight
and GPU-context integration use Claude/Opus with100 turns. No Luna or Gemini
experiments are scheduled. Budgets are smaller for the no-new-source ARC slot.

Planning checks: Roadmap schema; exact full task/table/digest equality; private
staged, activated, consumed-stage and prompt-mutation authority checks; every
structured gate and prior-failure record; exclusion and ARC/overdue lints;
existing schema/gate/authority tests and applicable private E2E-018; scoped Ruff
and spec traceability. Do not run the historical E2E-018 live publication command
against a newer roadmap; exercise its private CLI routes instead.

Experiment checks remain pending: spec first, traced tests first,100% changed-code
coverage, scoped types/lint, task-specific E2E, raw cold replay, adversarial and
strict row checks on final published bytes. Existing repository-wide health
failures remain visible without being recast as owned scientific failures.
No implementation changes, active-roadmap changes, conductor-source changes,
external publication or pushes are part of this planning task.
